render_free_512mb_safety_analysis.assessment: DistilGPT-2 (FP32) + PyTorch BiLSTM combined consumes 727.41 MB peak RSS during active generation. On Render Free (512 MB hard RAM ceiling), running combined active inference produces a deficit of 215.41 MB headroom, which triggers Linux OOM-killer (exit 137 / SIGKILL) on sustained transformer generation. Serving DistilGPT-2 safely in production requires either Option A (independent microservice deployment) or Option C (upgrading to a Render Starter instance with >=1 GB RAM). The technical PyTorch BiLSTM operates safely at 381.08 MB RSS (131+ MB headroom).
